title: Create a new comment on an owned video
content_data:
Use this endpoint to create a new comment on an organic video posted by an owned TikTok Account. > **Note**
> - To prevent comments from being flagged as spam and subsequently hidden by the system, avoid posting a high volume of comments with largely similar content within a short timeframe. If a comment is flagged as spam, you will not receive the [comment.update](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1810515104773122) webhook event with `comment_action` set to `set_to_public`. > - The comment webhook event [comment.update](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1810515104773122) enables you to get notifications within five minutes of a comment being created on any public video associated with an owned TikTok account. To subscribe to the comment webhook, see [Subscribe to the comment update event](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1810521730276354#item-link-Subscribe%20to%20the%20comment%20update%20event). ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/business/comments/create/|/v1.3/business/comment/create/| |New request parameters| / |`image_uri`
`image_width`
`image_height` |New response parameters| / |`unique_identifier`
`image_url`| ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/comment/create/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by TikTok creators.
To obtain an access token, use [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1833997638479041).| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{20%}|Data Type{10%}| Param Location{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- |--- | | business_id {Required} | string | Body | Application specific unique identifier for the TikTok account.
Pass the value of the `open_id` field returned in the response of [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1833997638479041) to this field.| | video_id {Required} | string | Body | Unique identifier for owned TikTok video to create comments on. This can be accessed via the [/business/video/list/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1762228421622786) endpoint as the `item_id` for each video listed. | | text {+Conditional} | string | | Either `text` or `image_uri` must be specified.

Text for the comment reply.

Length limit: 1,200 characters (UTF-8 encoding).

Example: "This is a comment #comment 🙂".| | image_uri {+Conditional} | string | | Either `text` or `image_uri` must be specified.

URI for the reply image.

To obtain the image URI, call the [/business/comment/image/upload/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1856212334897154) endpoint first.

Example: `54ccb875ae0c4368b94037d03a95b633`| | image_width {+Conditional} | integer | | Required when `image_uri` is specified.

The width of the image.

To obtain the image width, call the [/business/comment/image/upload/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1856212334897154) endpoint first.| | image_height {+Conditional} | integer | | Required when `image_uri` is specified.

The height of the image.

To obtain the image height, call the [/business/comment/image/upload/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1856212334897154) endpoint first.

Note: This value is from [/business/comment/image/upload/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1856212334897154) response.

| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/comment/create/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "business_id":"{{business_id}}", "video_id":"{{video_id}}", "text":"{{text}}" }' (/code) ``` ## Response **Header** These are important headers to record for issue reports and troubleshooting. This is not an exhaustive list of response headers. ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| | Date | string | Date and time (GMT) when the response was received.
Example: Fri, 13 Aug 2021 08:04:42 GMT | | X-Tt-Logid | string | Unique identifier for the API request. | ``` **Body** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |-|-|-| | request_id | string | Unique identifier for the API request.

Please record this field for all API requests. Important for issue reports and troubleshooting. | | code | Integer | Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| | message | string | Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Information](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | | data | object | Returned data. | #|comment_id| string | Unique identifier for the newly created comment.

Example: 6990565363377392901| #|video_id | string | Unique identifier for the owned video the comment was created on.

Example: 6990565363377392901| #|user_id {-To-be-deprecated}| string | Developer application and TikTok account scoped unique identifier for the user that made the comment.

Example: ce9b7be629b0447af777a0ad945783f61b7f790982b49fbda04a23b4722eaffe

Note: This field will be deprecated in the next API version. We recommend using `unique_identifier` to identify the TikTok user because the identifier remains consistent across different APIs.| #| unique_identifier | string | A globally unique identifier assigned to each user commenting. This identifier remains consistent across different APIs, facilitating cross-referencing and integration.

Example: +ABc1D2/E0fGhijklMNOrD34vDW/zDiZUNRH5Jyahue6OcA7b8ZpwnqXV9u1Uh+k | #| create_time | string | Unix/Epoch date-time when the comment was created.

Example: 1627617835 | #| text | string | Text content of the comment.

Example: "This is a comment #comment 🙂" | #| image_url | string | A URL to an image in the comment.

Returned if the comment is an image.

The URL won't expire.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "unique_identifier": "{{unique_identifier}}", "comment_id": "{{comment_id}}", "text": "{{text}}", "video_id": "{{video_id}}", "create_time": "1717489600", "user_id": "{{user_id}}" } } (/code) ```
